outcomes.definition: Every contributing registration declares this primary, so the OUTCOME limb passes. That is why an outcome-only screen passed this page and why it is not poolable on a different limb.
outcomes.measure_note: THE GENERATOR'S OWN IDIOM FOR ABSENCE. This topic publishes no estimate, so there is no measure it was expressed in. Not a borrowed value: sibling objects whose estimate was WITHDRAWN legitimately carry the withdrawn measure, which is a different case.
outcomes.definition_note: Registered endpoint definitions are recorded per trial on this object.

six_minute_walk.poolable_reason: THE TWO TRIALS ARE IN TWO DIFFERENT DISEASES. Read from ClinicalTrials.gov 2026-08-18: NCT00810693 enrols PULMONARY ARTERIAL HYPERTENSION and NCT00855465 enrols CHRONIC THROMBOEMBOLIC PULMONARY HYPERTENSION. Both test riociguat against placebo and both register a six-minute-walk primary -- so the intervention, comparator and outcome limbs all pass, and an outcome-only screen passed this page. THE PARTICIPANTS LIMB FAILS. CTEPH is a different disease from PAH, with a different mechanism and different management, and this topic is titled for PAH. THE ENDPOINTS ALSO SIT AT DIFFERENT TIMEPOINTS: week 12 against week 16. FOR THE QUESTION THE TITLE ASKS, THIS IS k=1, and a single trial is reported as a single trial, not pooled.

six_minute_walk.what_this_verdict_does_not_establish: NOT that the trials are poor -- each is registered, randomised and reports its primary. NOT that the drug is ineffective. NOT that no poolable question exists in this area -- only that the one this page's title asks cannot be answered by pooling the trials on it.
six_minute_walk.poolable_DEPRECATED_note: `poolable` MEANT ONLY 'the source page pooled these trials'. It was never a judgement that the pool was sound, and the renderer read it as permission to assert 'pooled on the X scale'. RENAMED to source_page_pooled, which is what it says. `poolable` is retained so nothing breaks, and it is DEPRECATED: read source_page_pooled for what the source did, and estimand_established for whether the pool is defensible. A PAGE SHOULD DISPLAY A POOLED ESTIMATE BECAUSE ITS ESTIMAND WAS ESTABLISHED, NOT BECAUSE SOMEONE ONCE POOLED IT.
six_minute_walk.estimand_established_means: TRUE only where every contributing trial has been READ and shown to measure the same quantity, or the same construct with a variance stated. FALSE where that was checked and failed. NULL where it was never checked -- AN ABSENT ASSERTION AND A NEGATIVE ONE ARE DIFFERENT STATES and null is not a pass.

risk_of_bias_verdict: Not assessed. A risk-of-bias assessment grades the trials contributing to a result, and this page contributes none. Stated rather than left blank.
